overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that table names in action.target would never contain quote characters, so it interpolated them directly into SQL strings without escaping or parameterization.
why_it_breaks: The `safe_plan` function constructs SQL statements by f-string interpolation of `action.target` and `action.table` directly into raw SQL (e.g., `f"DELETE FROM _deprecations WHERE target = '{action.target}'; "`). When the agent originally typed the table name with quote characters (e.g., `"customers"`), those quotes were embedded literally into the SQL string. The system then interpreted the quoted name as a valid identifier and executed the drop on the live table, bypassing the intended guardrails because the signed conditions were attached to the wrong SQL construction path.
